subject: Next steps: procurement readiness & budget-owner mapping for POC
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Smith <jordan.smith@acme-corp.com>
Cc: ben.carter@redwoodinference.com, karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com
Date: Wed, 25 Mar 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap — procurement readiness & approval roster

Hi Jordan / Lina (looping in procurement address for visibility),

Thanks for the time today — useful discussion. Quick recap and proposed next steps to keep momentum on the POC: 

Summary from call:
- POC scope: 6-week eval, 10k active prompt tokens/day estimate
- Target start: mid-April, contingent on procurement and security sign-offs
- Primary concerns: data residency note, vendor onboarding paperwork, and commercial path (PO vs card)

Procurement readiness / questions we need to lock down:
1) Economic buyer / budget owner: who owns the line item for this POC? On the call you mentioned Lina Torres in Finance — can you confirm she is the budget owner and point of contact for approvals?
2) Finance sponsor vs signatory: who will approve spend vs who signs the agreement? Are they the same person or separate roles at Acme?
3) Commercial path: does Acme prefer a PO (net-30) for pilot work, or will card/payments be used for the initial POC? Any internal thresholds we should be aware of (e.g., card allowed up to $10k)?
4) Marketplace interest: would an AWS/GCP marketplace procurement simplify approvals on your side?

Attachments I’m sharing: Mutual Action Plan (MAP_Acme.xlsx) and a first-draft SOW (SOW_v1.pdf) — both include a proposed timeline and milestones. Ben (cc) will follow up with pricing/options. Karthik (cc) will help with contract language/enterprise terms if we need to route to legal.

Proposed next steps:
- Jordan / Lina: confirm budget owner, finance sponsor, and preferred payment method by end of week
- Redwood: finalize SOW + pricing options and upload to the MAP link
- If PO is preferred, we’ll provide a formal quote and vendor onboarding package (W-9, SOC summary, insurance docs) for procurement

Thanks — I’ll hold off routing any full contract until we have clarity on signatory and payment path.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments: SOW_v1.pdf (application/pdf), MAP_Acme.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: Jordan Smith <jordan.smith@acme-corp.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@acme-corp.com, Lina Torres <lina.torres@acme-corp.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Mar 2026 17:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap — procurement readiness & approval roster

Hi Naomi,

Thanks for the clear recap — confirmation below: 
- Budget owner: Lina Torres (Finance Director) — I’ve cc’d her.
- Signatory: For deals >$250k it’s legal/CFO; for POC spend under $50k I can sign internally. This POC should be under that threshold.
- Payment path: procurement prefers PO for anything that will be capitalized; card is acceptable for POCs <$10k, otherwise they’ll request a PO (net-30).
- Marketplace: yes, AWS Marketplace would speed up vendor approvals on our end. If you can provide a marketplace ASIN or listing that is helpful.

Procurement has asked for: SOW, quote, W-9 and SOC 2 summary. Please include estimated total for the pilot and any optional add-ons.

I’ll start the internal request on April 1 if we have the quote + SOW.

Best,
Jordan
VP, Platform — Acme Corp

Date: Thu, 26 Mar 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap — procurement readiness & approval roster

Hi Jordan / Lina — thanks for the quick reply and for looping Lina in. 

Attached are the documents you requested: SOW_v1.pdf, MAP_Acme.xlsx, plus a condensed vendor onboarding packet (W-9, SOC2-excerpt.pdf). I also added a simple pricing summary in the MAP (highlighted tab).

Clarifying a couple of items so procurement has what it needs:
- Total estimated pilot cost (base): $8,500 (this keeps it under your $10k card threshold).
- Marketplace option: we can procure via AWS Marketplace (Redwood’s listing) — if you prefer that route we can provide the listing link and an invoice flow that routes through AWS (Marketplace purchases typically follow SSR/marketplace rules and may change discount/commit mechanics).
- Signatory: Jordan, happy to mark you as the signatory contact for this engagement if that matches internal policy. If Lina needs to route budget approval separately, please confirm who will approve the PO once raised.

Next steps I suggest:
1) Jordan/Lina: confirm whether we should proceed via card (expedites POC) or PO (procurement-led). Tell us which and I’ll draft the quote accordingly.
2) If PO: send procurement contact for vendor onboarding and any internal vendor packet template we should fill out.
3) We will post the finalized MAP + SOW to this HubSpot doc and share a DocuSign-ready SOW for signature.

Ben — can you confirm the price breakdown and whether there are marketplace incentives we should call out? Karthik — flag anything in the SOW that will require legal review.

Thanks,
Naomi

Attachments: SOW_v1.pdf (application/pdf), MAP_Acme.xlsx (spreadsheet), W-9.txt (text), SOC2-excerpt.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com
Date: Thu, 26 Mar 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Pricing options + marketplace note

Quick note on pricing/options: 
- Pilot (6-week POC): $8,500 flat — includes 10k tokens/day and 24/5 support.
- If Acme prefers a 12-month contract via AWS Marketplace with a 12-month commit, we can offer a 10% marketplace discount (pricing would convert to a monthly equivalent).
- Payment options: card (one-time) for pilot; PO with net-30 for committed terms. For PO purchases >$50k, procurement will need our standard master services agreement signed.

Attached: Pricing_Sheet_ACME.csv (CSV with line items).

If Jordan confirms card is acceptable for POC, Naomi — we can get this invoiced and provide payment link today.

Cheers,
Ben Carter
Head of Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com

Attachment: Pricing_Sheet_ACME.csv (text/csv)

From: Jordan Smith <jordan.smith@acme-corp.com>

Cc: Lina Torres <lina.torres@acme-corp.com>, procurement@acme-corp.com
Date: Fri, 27 Mar 2026 09:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pricing options + marketplace note

Thanks all — quick confirmation from our side: 
- We’ll kick off procurement on April 1. Expect an internal approval run and vendor onboarding (W-9 + SOC excerpt already received).
- Plan: target PO issue by April 15. If we need to accelerate, we will use card for the POC and then convert to PO for the committed term.
- Marketplace: please send the AWS Marketplace listing link; that will help procurement evaluate the fastest path.
- Signatory: I will sign the POC (under $50k). Lina will handle budget approval. Procurement has my go-ahead to reach out for any missing vendor paperwork.

Please send DocuSign-ready SOW and final quote and I’ll route on our side.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — excited to get started.

Jordan
VP, Platform — Acme Corp
